summary: The August 12 screening emphasizes finite-density baryon-susceptibility extraction from RHIC BES proton cumulants, ALICE ultra-central Pb-Pb flow ratios, EPOS4 soft-observable scaling from Pb-Pb and Xe-Xe toward O-O, and ML methods with concrete detector or PDE-surrogate transfer value. The strongest scientific item is the Bayesian susceptibility extraction; the most useful AI/ML items concern photon-pileup recovery and derivative computation in PINNs. Caution is warranted for model-injected CME claims, rotating-HRG vorticity extraction from yield ratios, and ML-assisted pole extraction with limited visible validation.
